title: KAITO — Icy Quarrel〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know I told you this just before, but I don't approve of your way of doing things...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't think that your solution is always the best one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You have no right asking such a question!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I never intended on seeking your approval.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My stance is simply that standing around idly will change nothing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Our methods are fundamentally at odds with one another. That isn't going to change moving forward...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I appreciate the fact that you didn't forcibly try to learn what Mizuki is dealing with...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (That's rich, considering you looked like you were about to bite my head off if I broached the topic...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If that's all you have to say, then I'll be going now...
MEIKO, KAITO, do you both have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You two were having a rather animated conversation just now. Are you all finished?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're not going to fool me.
We saw everything with our own eyes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh dear...
Maybe it's time I scolded the both of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're scared because a certain pair of people have been shouting at each other without any regard for those around them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, why are you at each other's throats...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm here to help broker a peace deal between you two, so please try to make up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're trying to get us to make up...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh...
Does that mean you two have already come to some sort of understanding?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Interpret it however you like.
More to the point, you seem like the worst person to be a diplomat.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll fairly listen to what you two have to say and scold you both accordingly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's collective punishment for the involved parties, no...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making everyone feel scared...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However... We are done discussing this matter, as KAITO just said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you two make it official by shaking hands?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Please don't forget what I just said.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like I'll be waiting for a while longer...
